cards.title: 说明

body.p: 官方规格列出写作部分共 12 题，预计 23 分钟：Build a Sentence 10 题、Write an Email 1 题、Write for an Academic Discussion 1 题。邮件限时 7 分钟，学术讨论限时 10 分钟。
本课只考连词成句，限时 6 分钟。邮件和学术讨论的限时写作，在各自的练习里完成。本课成绩不代表这两项写作的分数。
每题先读前一句，再把词块排成一句完整的回应。已给的句首、句尾和标点不动，有一个词块用不上。

body.box:
Context: Is the delivery complete?
Given beginning: I am
Blocks: not / sure / whether / it is / does
Given ending: complete.
Sentence: I am not sure whether it is complete.

body.p: 例句中 whether 后面用陈述语序 it is，does 是多余的词块。排好后再核对主谓一致、动词形式、固定搭配和时间，如有 yesterday 就用过去时。

cards.src: spec 第 6 页；overview 第 14–15 页；lessonplan 第 7 页
cards.note: 6 分钟是本课程定的时间。spec 表格只给出写作部分的总时长，没有单列连词成句的时间。

items.stem: Can we use the electronic scoreboard for this afternoon's match?
items.why: whether 引导间接问句，用陈述语序：the scoreboard has been repaired。这里用不上 does。

items.stem: Who designed the signs near the new entrance?
items.why: who created the campus logo 修饰 designer，also designed 是主句谓语。指人用 who，不用 which。

items.stem: Does the revised shuttle route take more time?
items.why: much 修饰比较级 longer，than 引出 the old one。longer 已是比较级，不再加 more。

items.stem: Where is the stapler that was on this table?
items.why: have put 是现在完成时。代词 it 放在 put 和 back 之间。have 后面不接 putting。

items.stem: Why did the walkers reach a closed path?
items.why: told 后面接人 us 和 that 从句。从句是 the path was closed，用不上 did。

items.stem: Are the safety shoes suitable for an entire workday?
items.why: not comfortable enough for long shifts 表示不够舒适。enough 放在形容词后面，too 不能放在这里。

items.stem: The deadline for choosing a research topic is tomorrow.
items.why: need to decide 后面接 which topic I will choose。间接问句用陈述语序。will 已是助动词，不再加 do。

items.stem: Would a daytime ferry ticket cost as much as a night ticket?
items.why: not as expensive as 表示更便宜。as … as 是固定结构，不能换成 than。

items.stem: Did the equipment custodian give the climbing ropes back?
items.why: has already returned the ropes 是现在完成时，already 在 has 和过去分词之间。has 后面不接 returning。

items.stem: Can the volunteers enter the greenhouse before the guide arrives?
items.why: must 后面接原形 wait。until 后面是完整的从句 the guide opens the gate，opening 不能作谓语。
